subject: Fix grammar errors in code comments (#3729)
reason: The change (#3729) only fixes grammar in C code comments across aof.c, cluster_legacy.c, db.c, entry.c, eval.c, latency.c, module.c, t_set.c, t_stream.c, util.c, valkey-check-aof.c, valkeymodule.h and ziplist.c. No executable statement, constant, reply text, or configuration is touched, so compiled behaviour is identical to the parent and no scenario can distinguish the builds.
